items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Neil Sedaka was one of the writers too.

ctx.x: Yeah they just churned out those tunes.

And all Al would do is pick up the phone and call Connie Francis or somebody, “Hey we need a tenth song for the album.” Boom they shoot down and they had demos made. They made them down in the cellar of the same building, churn them out. Neil Sedaka was one of the writers too. They all became very, very big you know.
So if you were to listen, to sit and listen to the oldies radio station — oldies meaning ‘50s and ‘60s music — you’re likely to hear yourself now and then, right?
